# sast-rules-mini

> Lightweight static analysis for Python: ten AST security rules with import alias tracking, inline suppressions, text output and SARIF 2.1.0 with code point columns Python package `trysac-sast-rules-mini`, import name `sast_rules_mini`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
